expertText:
* = $0801



; --------------------------------------------------
; RAM variables
; --------------------------------------------------
.const frame_idx = $C100
.const points    = $C110     ; 16 bytes: x0,y0,x1,y1...x7,y7

.const src_lo    = $09
.const src_hi    = $0A

.const x0v       = $20
.const y0v       = $21
.const x1v       = $22
.const y1v       = $23
.const dxv       = $24
.const dyv       = $25
.const sxv       = $26
.const syv       = $27
.const errv      = $28
.const cntv      = $29
.const dx2v      = $2A
.const dy2v      = $2B
.const edge_idx  = $2C

start:
    SEI

; VIC bank 0: $0000-$3FFF
    LDA $DD00
    AND #%11111100
    ORA #%00000011
    STA $DD00

; hires bitmap on
    LDA #$3B
    STA $D011

; make sure multicolor bitmap is off
    LDA $D016
    AND #%11101111
    STA $D016

; screen=$0400, bitmap=$2000
    LDA #$18
    STA $D018

; black border/background
    LDA #$00
    STA $D020
    STA $D021

; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg
    LDA #$10
    LDX #$00
fill_scr1:
    STA $0400,X
    STA $0500,X
    STA $0600,X
    INX
    BNE fill_scr1

    LDX #$00
fill_scr2:
    STA $0700,X
    INX
    CPX #$E8
    BNE fill_scr2

    LDA #$00
    STA frame_idx

main_loop:
    JSR wait_vblank
    JSR clear_bitmap
    JSR load_frame
    JSR draw_cube

    INC frame_idx
    LDA frame_idx
    AND #$0F
    STA frame_idx

    JMP main_loop

; --------------------------------------------------
; wait vblank
; --------------------------------------------------
wait_vblank:
wv1:
    LDA $D012
    CMP #$F8
    BCC wv1
wv2:
    LDA $D012
    CMP #$F8
    BCS wv2
    RTS

; --------------------------------------------------
; clear bitmap $2000-$3F3F
; --------------------------------------------------
clear_bitmap:
    LDA #$20
    STA $FE
    LDA #$00
    STA $FD
    LDX #$1F
    LDY #$00
cb_page:
    STA ($FD),Y
    INY
    BNE cb_page
    INC $FE
    DEX
    BNE cb_page

    LDY #$00
cb_tail:
    STA ($FD),Y
    INY
    CPY #$40
    BNE cb_tail
    RTS

; --------------------------------------------------
; load current frame -> points
; --------------------------------------------------
load_frame:
    LDA frame_idx
    ASL
    TAX
    LDA frame_table,X
    STA src_lo
    INX
    LDA frame_table,X
    STA src_hi

    LDY #$00
lf_loop:
    LDA (src_lo),Y
    STA points,Y
    INY
    CPY #$10
    BNE lf_loop
    RTS

; --------------------------------------------------
; draw all 12 edges
; --------------------------------------------------
draw_cube:
    LDA #$00
    STA edge_idx

dc_loop:
    LDY edge_idx

    LDA cube_edges,Y
    ASL
    TAX
    LDA points,X
    STA x0v
    LDA points+1,X
    STA y0v

    INY
    LDA cube_edges,Y
    ASL
    TAX
    LDA points,X
    STA x1v
    LDA points+1,X
    STA y1v

    JSR draw_line

    LDA edge_idx
    CLC
    ADC #$02
    STA edge_idx
    CMP #24
    BNE dc_loop
    RTS

; --------------------------------------------------
; Bresenham
; --------------------------------------------------
draw_line:
; dx = abs(x1-x0), sx = sign(x1-x0)
    LDA x1v
    SEC
    SBC x0v
    BCS dl_dx_pos
    EOR #$FF
    CLC
    ADC #$01
    STA dxv
    LDA #$FF
    STA sxv
    JMP dl_dy_calc

dl_dx_pos:
    STA dxv
    LDA #$01
    STA sxv

; dy = abs(y1-y0), sy = sign(y1-y0)
dl_dy_calc:
    LDA y1v
    SEC
    SBC y0v
    BCS dl_dy_pos
    EOR #$FF
    CLC
    ADC #$01
    STA dyv
    LDA #$FF
    STA syv
    JMP dl_pre

dl_dy_pos:
    STA dyv
    LDA #$01
    STA syv

dl_pre:
    LDA dxv
    ASL
    STA dx2v
    LDA dyv
    ASL
    STA dy2v

    LDA dxv
    CMP dyv
    BCC dl_y_major

; X-major
    LDA dy2v
    SEC
    SBC dxv
    STA errv

    LDA dxv
    STA cntv

dl_x_loop:
    LDA x0v
    LDX y0v
    JSR setpixel

    LDA errv
    BMI dl_x_no_y
    BEQ dl_x_no_y

    LDA y0v
    CLC
    ADC syv
    STA y0v

    LDA errv
    SEC
    SBC dx2v
    STA errv

dl_x_no_y:
    LDA errv
    CLC
    ADC dy2v
    STA errv

    LDA x0v
    CLC
    ADC sxv
    STA x0v

    DEC cntv
    BPL dl_x_loop
    RTS

; Y-major
dl_y_major:
    LDA dx2v
    SEC
    SBC dyv
    STA errv

    LDA dyv
    STA cntv

dl_y_loop:
    LDA x0v
    LDX y0v
    JSR setpixel

    LDA errv
    BMI dl_y_no_x
    BEQ dl_y_no_x

    LDA x0v
    CLC
    ADC sxv
    STA x0v

    LDA errv
    SEC
    SBC dy2v
    STA errv

dl_y_no_x:
    LDA errv
    CLC
    ADC dx2v
    STA errv

    LDA y0v
    CLC
    ADC syv
    STA y0v

    DEC cntv
    BPL dl_y_loop
    RTS

; --------------------------------------------------
; setpixel
; in: A=x, X=y
; --------------------------------------------------
setpixel:
    STA $FB
    STX $FC

; row block = y >> 3
    TXA
    LSR
    LSR
    LSR
    TAX
    LDA row320lo,X
    STA $FD
    LDA row320hi,X
    STA $FE

; x byte = x >> 3
    LDA $FB
    LSR
    LSR
    LSR
    STA $05

; add xbyte*8
    LDA #$00
    STA $06
    LDA $05
    ASL
    ROL $06
    ASL
    ROL $06
    ASL
    ROL $06

    CLC
    ADC $FD
    STA $FD
    LDA $06
    ADC $FE
    STA $FE

; add bitmap base $2000
    CLC
    LDA $FE
    ADC #$20
    STA $FE

; add (y & 7)
    LDA $FC
    AND #$07
    CLC
    ADC $FD
    STA $FD
    BCC sp_ok
    INC $FE
sp_ok:

; set bit
    LDA $FB
    AND #$07
    TAX
    LDA bitmask,X
    LDY #$00
    ORA ($FD),Y
    STA ($FD),Y
    RTS

; --------------------------------------------------
; edge list
; same fixed 8 vertices every frame
; --------------------------------------------------
cube_edges:
.byte 0,1, 1,2, 2,3, 3,0
.byte 4,5, 5,6, 6,7, 7,4
.byte 0,4, 1,5, 2,6, 3,7

; --------------------------------------------------
; 16 precomputed perspective frames
; vertex order is ALWAYS:
; 0..3 front face, 4..7 back face
; --------------------------------------------------
frame_table:
.byte <frame_0,  >frame_0
.byte <frame_1,  >frame_1
.byte <frame_2,  >frame_2
.byte <frame_3,  >frame_3
.byte <frame_4,  >frame_4
.byte <frame_5,  >frame_5
.byte <frame_6,  >frame_6
.byte <frame_7,  >frame_7
.byte <frame_8,  >frame_8
.byte <frame_9,  >frame_9
.byte <frame_10, >frame_10
.byte <frame_11, >frame_11
.byte <frame_12, >frame_12
.byte <frame_13, >frame_13
.byte <frame_14, >frame_14
.byte <frame_15, >frame_15

frame_0:
.byte 144,108, 176,108, 179,74, 141,74, 136,132, 184,132, 190,85, 130,85
frame_1:
.byte 151,106, 183,112, 187,76, 150,73, 132,125, 174,137, 178,88, 125,82
frame_2:
.byte 160,105, 188,118, 193,79, 160,73, 132,118, 160,140, 160,89, 127,79
frame_3:
.byte 169,106, 188,125, 195,82, 170,73, 137,112, 146,137, 142,88, 133,76
frame_4:
.byte 176,108, 184,132, 190,85, 179,74, 144,108, 136,132, 130,85, 141,74
frame_5:
.byte 183,112, 174,137, 178,88, 187,76, 151,106, 132,125, 125,82, 150,73
frame_6:
.byte 188,118, 160,140, 160,89, 193,79, 160,105, 132,118, 127,79, 160,73
frame_7:
.byte 188,125, 146,137, 142,88, 195,82, 169,106, 137,112, 133,76, 170,73
frame_8:
.byte 184,132, 136,132, 130,85, 190,85, 176,108, 144,108, 141,74, 179,74
frame_9:
.byte 174,137, 132,125, 125,82, 178,88, 183,112, 151,106, 150,73, 187,76
frame_10:
.byte 160,140, 132,118, 127,79, 160,89, 188,118, 160,105, 160,73, 193,79
frame_11:
.byte 146,137, 137,112, 133,76, 142,88, 188,125, 169,106, 170,73, 195,82
frame_12:
.byte 136,132, 144,108, 141,74, 130,85, 184,132, 176,108, 179,74, 190,85
frame_13:
.byte 132,125, 151,106, 150,73, 125,82, 174,137, 183,112, 187,76, 178,88
frame_14:
.byte 132,118, 160,105, 160,73, 127,79, 160,140, 188,118, 193,79, 160,89
frame_15:
.byte 137,112, 169,106, 170,73, 133,76, 146,137, 188,125, 195,82, 142,88

row320lo:
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00

row320hi:
.byte $00,$01,$02,$03,$05,$06,$07,$08
.byte $0A,$0B,$0C,$0D,$0F,$10,$11,$12
.byte $14,$15,$16,$17,$19,$1A,$1B,$1C
.byte $1E

bitmask:
.byte $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01
